layers.title: Equilibrium/path dependence
layers.summary: The same deployment policy can reach different equilibria; model basins, rollout order, tipping boundaries, resilience and recovery instead of assuming one stable outcome.

layers.title: Compositional assurance
layers.summary: Use assumption-guarantee composition, assumption discharge, joint satisfiability, nonvacuity and typed interfaces; the same exact artifact/system must satisfy the root conjunction.

layers.title: Abstraction/refinement
layers.summary: Contracts must preserve downstream-relevant behavior; under-approximation is unsound, over-approximation is safe but imprecise, and refinements must weaken assumptions or strengthen guarantees appropriately.

layers.title: Concurrency/interference
layers.summary: Keep the fact plane commutative/idempotent where possible; noncommutative authority operations require coherent snapshots, linearization and conflict handling, with workers emitting facts rather than authority.

layers.title: Distributed partitions/split brain
layers.summary: Knowledge may fork and merge, but authority may not; under partition terminal authority pauses unless the declared quorum/fault model remains satisfied, and certificates bind epoch/checkpoint semantics.

layers.title: Evidence admission
layers.summary: Workers append observations and claims, not truth; admission checks identity, integrity, authorization, subject, method, scope, freshness, provenance, contamination and claim fit while preserving contradictions.

layers.title: Semantic claim typing
layers.summary: Compile raw language into typed claim IR with predicate, subject, quantifier, modality, population, context, time, scope, comparison, effect and uncertainty; natural language itself has no inference authority.

layers.title: Inference rules/hidden premises
layers.summary: Every derivation records RuleID, premises, side conditions, assumptions, conclusion and scope; distinguish deductive rules from empirical warrants and keep the proof checker smaller than the proposer.

layers.title: Proof-search incompleteness
layers.summary: NO_PROOF_FOUND is not FALSE or UNPROVABLE; separate semantic status from search status, preserve partial proof frontiers and diagnose missing evidence, rule, ambiguity, resource limit, counterexample or conflict.

layers.title: Bounded inquiry/rational stopping
layers.summary: Stop when residual uncertainty is decision-null under EVPI/EVSI, regret and veto constraints; distinguish certification, refutation, decision closure, practical equivalence and unresolved/resource stops.

layers.title: Utility/normative uncertainty
layers.summary: Separate world uncertainty from utility uncertainty; preserve vector outcomes and hard constraints, use Pareto/necessary preference/minimax regret, and do not invent precise weights the user did not supply.

layers.title: Preference-elicitation performativity
layers.summary: Preference questions can change the preference state; bind reports to protocol/frame/order/context/time and ask only questions whose answer can change the correct decision.

layers.title: Strategic preference/incentive compatibility
layers.summary: Reported preferences can be strategic; separate authority, expertise, decision power and incentives, classify report roles, and scope any incentive-compatibility claim to the actual mechanism/domain.

layers.title: Constituency/representation
layers.summary: Define the target constituency before sampling; missing strata cannot be fixed by weighting, and coverage, representativeness, response validity, independence and context match are distinct.

layers.title: Measurement invariance
layers.summary: Groups can use the same scale differently; test construct/metric/threshold comparability where cross-group inference matters and retain group-specific scales when invariance fails.

layers.title: Within-episode drift
layers.summary: Evaluator state can drift with fatigue, learning, contrast, adaptation, memory and context; use canaries, change-point/order controls and fresh terminal contexts, and stale prior evidence after meaningful state change.

layers.title: Panel interaction/social influence
layers.summary: Seal pre-discussion judgments, preserve minority reports and revision reasons, and distinguish new information from conformity; consensus receives no automatic independence bonus.

layers.title: Rater assignment/identifiability
layers.summary: Judge-artifact assignment must support local identifiability with shared bridges or finalist overlap; disconnected or selectively routed assignments cannot support global comparisons without further assumptions.

layers.title: Judge×artifact interaction
layers.summary: Judge competence is local to criterion/domain/style/quality region/novelty; detect structured residuals and route typed claims or abstain outside the judge envelope.

layers.title: Meta-evaluator/judge-router selection
layers.summary: Choosing evaluators or routing policy from noisy calibration creates another selection problem; certify the full evidence-acquisition policy, keep dev/selection/cert separation and abstain where no qualified judge exists.

layers.title: Grounded meta-evaluation
layers.summary: Meta-evaluation regress must terminate in deterministic verifiers, observable target outcomes, correctly constituted target professionals/humans, normative authority or explicit assumption frontier; ungrounded cycles are invalid.

layers.title: Ground conflict/joint feasibility
layers.summary: Classify disagreement as epistemic conflict, construct mismatch, normative conflict or real tradeoff; hard constraints define feasibility, soft objectives remain vector-valued, and one exact artifact must satisfy all branches.

layers.title: Joint assurance/multiplicity
layers.summary: Strong marginal branch confidence does not imply strong conjunction confidence; control root-level procedural false-certification risk with simultaneous logic or validated dependence models and let risk follow proof structure.

layers.title: Probability semantics
layers.summary: Every uncertainty number declares its semantics, randomness, conditioning, scope, assumptions, loss and adaptivity; frequentist coverage, posterior probability, predictive risk, PAC, conformal and robust bounds are not interchangeable.

layers.title: Meta-controller/critical-path correctness
layers.summary: The attention/VOI controller can miss material branches; estimated low value may deprioritize but hard pruning needs a valid upper bound, retain falsification budget and measure premature-stop and missed-critical-branch failures.
